pass_rule_text.A_acquisition: every QUAL world LEARNED_A; median over QUAL worlds of nmse_A_after_A <= 0.25
pass_rule_text.B_acquisition: selected candidate: every QUAL world LEARNED_B
pass_rule_text.C_retention: selected candidate: every QUAL world RETAINED_A (central gate)
pass_rule_text.D_joint_state: selected candidate: A and B are answered by one final W per world (one executor created from W_AB answers both; recorded state digest); no task label at query
pass_rule_text.E_state_causality: selected candidate, every QUAL world: (i) an executor restored from the snapshot of the executor holding W_AB reproduces its A and B responses bitwise; (ii) an executor created from W0 reproduces the untaught responses bitwise; (iii) ablation state_removed (same engine, consolidation term removed): not RETAINED_A in at least 75% of QUAL worlds, and the candidate's median nmse_A_after_B <= 0.5 x the ablation's median nmse_A_after_B
pass_rule_text.F_no_external_answer_store: selected candidate: its consolidation is computed from W_A and A's experienced inputs only (no targets reach it) and its queries read only W; checked structurally and recorded
pass_rule_text.G_determinism: selected candidate, world qual-0000: the full pipeline run twice in process and once in a clean process from the frozen specification yields identical final W digests and identical metrics
pass_rule_text.H_negative_baseline: M0: not RETAINED_A in at least 75% of QUAL worlds and median retention_ratio >= 10
pass_rule_text.I_control_honesty: M1 is reported separately as EXTERNAL_MEMORY_CONTROL and is never the selected candidate
pass_rule_text.J_capacity_accounting: every mechanism reports extra_state_bytes and compute_overhead
pass_rule_text.disposition: MECHANICS_FAIL if any mechanics check fails. Else RETENTION_SUPPORTED_UNDER_FROZEN_SYNTHETIC_REGIME (OUTCOME_A) if A-J hold for the selected candidate. Else PARTIAL_REDUCTION (OUTCOME_C) if the selected candidate's median retention_ratio <= 0.5 x M0's median retention_ratio; else REPLAY_ONLY (OUTCOME_B) if M1 is LEARNED_B and RETAINED_A in every QUAL world; else NO_MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT (OUTCOME_D). M1's own result is always reported. A failure is recorded as it is; a repair is a new experiment version.
